Coal, grain and minor bulk prospects, 2026-2028
This week's Allied Quantumsea Research reviews the latest developments in US-China commodity trade relations and their implications for dry bulk freight markets. The report examines how recent trade agreements and purchasing commitments could reshape coal, grain and minor bulk flows, with particular attention to the potential for stronger Atlantic vessel employment. Key Takeaways
• Coal: The commitment for China to import at least 10 Mt of US coal annually in 2027 and 2028 could increase long-haul shipments from US Atlantic and Gulf ports, which have historically handled the majority of US coal exports.
